title: Contract-diff validator onboarding storyboard and asset pack
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a visual onboarding flow and asset pack for the new JSON contract-diff validator feature. Deliverables include a 6-frame storyboard (first-run walkthrough), responsive product screenshots (desktop/tablet/mobile), annotated copydeck for microcopy, motion notes for the diff animation, and exportable PNG/SVG assets for docs and release notes. The validator UI should show three canonical states: 1) Valid — green badge with quick pass summary and sample payload preview; 2) Warning — yellow badge with non-blocking differences and a collapsible example list; 3) Error — red badge with line-level diff highlighting, suggested auto-fix chips, and a quick link to the failing prompt example. The design must account for long arrays and nested objects by using a compact preview + full-diff toggle, and include a focused keyboard-accessible mode for screenreader users. The pack must include copy variations for product, docs, and release notes, plus a short developer-facing hint card for SDKs. Link artifacts below for handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with completed 6-frame storyboard + annotated prototype (desktop/tablet/mobile)
Exported screenshots: 3 sizes for each of the 3 validator states (total 9 per breakpoint)
Copydeck in Google Drive with approved microcopy and localization keys
Design review recorded and signed off by PM & Eng (review comments addressed)
QA checklist documenting keyboard/screenreader flows and contrast ratios included
Handoff PR-ready asset bundle (PNGs, SVGs, copy snippets, motion spec) uploaded to assets repo
decisions: Use a split-diff view (expected vs actual) with inline suggested fixes rather than full-line collapse to keep context visible
Color palette: adopt amber for warnings instead of orange to differentiate from existing alert tones
Auto-suggest fixes presented as chips that can be applied one-by-one; no automatic mutation without explicit user action
Default to compact preview for large arrays, with 'show full diff' affordance to avoid noise for first-time users
Motion: subtle sliding diff highlight on focus to draw attention without disorienting users; 180ms duration
